title: Your next idea starts here.
description: The setup is done. A clean React foundation with useful defaults, a few example pages, and plenty of room to build something of your own.

features.title: Make it yours
features.description: Accessible shadcn/ui components, Tailwind utilities, and a theme you can change in one place.

features.title: Find your way around
features.description: Pages, layouts, and UI components have a home. No elaborate architecture to learn first.

features.title: Ship when you’re ready
features.description: Formatting, linting, type checks, and a Vercel configuration are already in place.
